reference: User attached concept: Ngự Kiếm Vượt Thiên Quan; style and subject guidance
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent PNG sprite atlas for an existing Vietnamese xianxia 2.5D sword-flight racing minigame, “Ngự Kiếm Vượt Thiên Quan”.
Reference role: the user's attached reference is style and subject guidance only. Create a new clean gameplay atlas, not a presentation poster.
Composition: EXACTLY EIGHT equal columns and SIX equal rows, all 48 square cells, landscape 4:3 ratio, ideally 1536x1152. No borders or spacing lines, no labels, NO TEXT. Each sprite stays within its cell with 12% transparent padding, uniform centering. Genuine transparent background throughout, no painted checkerboard, no black backdrop.
Style: polished hand-painted fantasy game sprites, crisp readable silhouettes, blue/cyan sword energy, gold ornament, pale jade stone and pink blossom accents, luminous but restrained glows. Consistent isometric 2.5D view.
Row 1, cells left to right: same youthful long-black-haired white-and-blue-robed cultivator STANDING ON a blue flying sword, full body and both feet visible, eight compass views in order south, southwest, west, northwest (back three-quarter), north (back), northeast (back three-quarter), east, southeast. Not holding a second weapon. Sword underneath feet, cohesive proportions. No portrait crop.
Row 2: eight distinct upright floating checkpoint gates, with transparent hollow openings: blue circular pagoda gate; gold rectangular heavenly gate; gold crescent moon gate; pink blossom circular gate; green jade dragon ring; orange dragon ring; silver-blue finish gate with twin small pennants; blue circular gate glowing successfully crossed.
Row 3: eight flight hazards: dark floating rocky boulder; smaller icy rock; blue spiral wind vortex; dark thundercloud with one lightning stroke; white crane with wings spread; purple rotating spirit blade obstacle; angular floating island rock; ring of storm wind.
Row 4: eight collectible and UI sprites: small green spirit orb; large blue spirit orb; rare purple spirit orb; gold speed boost chevrons; blue protective shield orb; gold time clock; emerald reward chest; ornate gold race trophy.
Row 5: eight animation frames, same horizontal blue comet sword-flight trail, left to right expanding from faint short streak to long crescent energy, all same alignment. Effects only, NO CHARACTER.
Row 6: eight scenic transparent isometric cloud-course pieces: grassy floating island with tiny blue pagoda; pink flowering tree on floating rock; curved jade stone sky bridge; small waterfall floating island; gold heavenly pavilion on rock; bamboo floating island; wispy white cloud cluster; distant pale-blue mountain spire.
Constraints: no UI screenshots, no interface panels, no lettering, no watermarks, no shadows connecting adjacent cells. Preserve real alpha. Gameplay-ready separated sprites only.
